title: H36: Retry-After capped at 24 hours (INVENTED)
description: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. Fanout honours Retry-After but caps it at MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS = 24 h so a hostile or broken value cannot stall a queue indefinitely; delay = max(doubling backoff 1 s..5 min, capped Retry-After). Approved by Mark 2026-10-18.
